name: Apache Spark (standalone or YARN)
sku: Apache Spark run on a Standalone or Hadoop YARN cluster that you operate, from the latest documentation (Spark 4.0 line). The engine is the same on every host, so this record and the Kubernetes and managed ones repeat its scores; what differs is who runs the cluster. Managed hosts are scored separately: Amazon EMR, Dataproc, Azure Synapse, Fabric Data Engineering and Databricks.

transform.code-transform.note: High-level APIs in Java, Scala, Python and R over an optimised engine that supports general execution graphs, plus the pandas API on Spark. You write and operate the code.

transform.stream-processing.note: Structured Streaming does incremental computation and stream processing on the same engine and APIs as batch.

transform.sql-transform.note: Spark SQL runs SQL over structured data. It has no models, dependency ordering or tests of its own, so SQL transformation projects add a framework on top.

transform.feature-eng.note: MLlib is the built-in machine learning library, with which features can be built. There is no feature store or serving layer.

serve.query-engine.note: Spark SQL is a SQL query engine over the same data. The overview does not describe serving many concurrent interactive users.

bands.note: A web UI for each running application shows tasks, executors and storage, a History Server replays finished runs, and a REST API and metrics sinks including Prometheus export the same data.

presentation.tagline: Open-source distributed engine for batch, streaming, SQL and machine learning code.
